bear_case.summary: Cheap on trailing numbers (fwd P/E 12.5) but the market is pricing terminal-value risk from agentic AI disintermediation of OTAs; Expedia is joining third-party agents (Meta Muse, ChatGPT, Gemini) that may own the customer relationship and compress take rates. H1-2026 earnings surged off a weak base, so trailing multiples may flatter. Consumer softness (payrolls +29k) adds cyclical travel risk.

thesis_breaking_risks.evidence: EXPE fell ~7.7% on 2026-09-23 after joining Meta's Muse agent; stock ~29% down YTD on OTA disintermediation fears (secondary).
thesis_breaking_risks.early_warning_signal: Direct-traffic share, B2C marketing efficiency and take-rate commentary in Q3 print (2026-10-29); booking volume routed via third-party agents

thesis_breaking_risks.evidence: Regime memo: Sept payrolls +29k, unemployment 4.2%, Fed hiking; travel is discretionary.
thesis_breaking_risks.early_warning_signal: Gross bookings/room-night growth deceleration; US vs international mix in Q3

thesis_breaking_risks.evidence: H1-26 net income $872M vs $130M H1-25; Q2 $878M vs $330M (10-Q). Composition of the jump not decomposed here (UNAVAILABLE).
thesis_breaking_risks.early_warning_signal: Q3 net income vs adjusted EBITDA divergence; other-income/tax items

thesis_breaking_risks.evidence: ANALYTICAL_INFERENCE: performance marketing costs rise if Google/AI surfaces charge more for placement.

accounting_quality_red_flags: Stock-based comp $217M in H1-26 (vs $203M) - material dilution offset by buybacks; ROE of 199% (screen) reflects tiny equity base from buybacks, not pure economics.
Long-term debt $5.46B at 2026-06-30 incl. new 5.5% 2036 notes ($986M) refinancing cheaper 2026 converts - interest cost rising.
Merchant model float (deferred merchant bookings) flatters FCF; any booking slowdown reverses working capital - figure UNAVAILABLE.
value_trap_assessment: Low P/E reflects a credible, unquantifiable risk to the long-term moat (AI agents owning travel intent); if take rate erodes, today's FCF is not durable and the multiple is fair.
